result_preview.title: BOM Compliance Validator Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously validates bill of materials against regulatory and supplier qualification requirements.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically scans product bills of materials to verify compliance with regulatory standards, restricted substance directives, and active supplier qualifications. It flags non-compliant materials and components, recommends approved substitutes, and generates compliance documentation for product records. This reduces manual review cycles and ensures products meet market-specific requirements before engineering release.
useCases: Verify all product components meet current regulatory and engineering standards
Confirm product specifications align with approved material lists before production
Engineering team confirms new product revision has compliant materials and components.
Quality assurance validates material changes against regulatory requirements before release.

result_preview.title: Supplier Qualification and Service Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages supplier qualifications, service requests, and equipment compliance tracking.
result_preview.description: Exposes supplier qualification records, service ticket management, and IT equipment compliance data across the product lifecycle. Retrieves and manages supplier assessment history, service incident tracking, and equipment configuration changes. Provides access to qualification audit trails and service performance metrics for procurement and operations teams.
useCases: Evaluate supplier technical qualification and service agreements
Procurement team matches order to certified vendors and creates service ticket for fulfillment
Confirm that selected vendors can meet delivery, quality, and support requirements for the change

Provides comprehensive analytics on procurement patterns, vendor reliability trends, and contract fulfillment to support strategic sourcing decisions and supply chain risk mitigation in manufacturing execution.
